          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,1.1,0.36>
}

camera {
  location < 0, 1.2, -16 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <0, 1.2, 999984>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))

#end
}
